bronze_plate_corselet.name: Bronze Plate Corselet
bronze_plate_corselet.observation: Chariot nobles ride in corselets of bronze plates that turn arrows and spear points.

chariot_runners.name: Chariot Runners
chariot_runners.observation: Fast foot soldiers run beside the chariots, screening them and finishing the enemies they break.

cut_and_thrust_sword.name: Cut-and-thrust Long Sword
cut_and_thrust_sword.observation: A long bronze blade with a strong tang both slashes and stabs, and holds together through a hard fight.

sally_ports_cistern_stairs.name: Sally Ports and Siege Cisterns
sally_ports_cistern_stairs.observation: Hidden gates let the defenders strike the besiegers' camp, and covered stairs reach a cistern the enemy cannot cut.

coastal_raider_watch.name: Coastal Raider Watch
coastal_raider_watch.observation: Lookouts on the headlands pass a signal fire along the coast when strange sails appear.

professional_corps.observation: Soldiers who serve for years, kept, fed and drilled by the ruler, stand ready in every season.
professional_corps.ability_reason: A general now commands men who know their trade, not farmers called away from the harvest.
professional_corps.social_consequence: Soldiers who owe everything to the ruler's pay can be turned against the people who feed them.

galley_navigation.observation: Oared war galleys keep station together and turn as one fleet at their commander's signal.

naval_arsenals.observation: Walled yards store the galleys, their oars and rigging, and keep shipwrights ready to refit a fleet in weeks.

amphibious_operations.observation: Galleys land troops on a hostile shore, beach for a raid, and take them off again before the enemy gathers.

iron_sword_issue.name: Iron Swords for Picked Troops
iron_sword_issue.observation: The ruler's smiths forge iron swords for his picked men; the blades are tougher and cheaper than bronze.
iron_sword_issue.ability_reason: Iron from common ore arms soldiers without waiting for tin from far away.

town_night_curfew.name: Town Night Curfew
town_night_curfew.observation: After the horn at dusk the quarters are barred, and anyone in the streets must answer to the watch.
town_night_curfew.social_consequence: Honest folk fume at the barred quarters, but thieves go hungry.

textile_armor_layering.observation: Many layers of linen glued and stitched together make a light corselet that stops arrows.

lamellar_armor_assembly.observation: Small plates laced in overlapping rows make armor that flexes with the body and can be mended plate by plate.

skirmisher_infantry_screens.observation: Javelin men and slingers screen the formed infantry and fall back through its ranks when the enemy closes.

iron_arrowheads.name: Bulk Iron Arrowheads
iron_arrowheads.observation: Smiths turn out iron arrowheads by the basket, and archers no longer hoard every point.

armored_riding.observation: Riders in scale and lamellar on trained horses can charge into the archers' shot and live through it.

mounted_archery.ability_reason: Horse archers strike and ride off before foot soldiers can close; a general can harry an army for days.

siege_engineering.observation: Engineers plan ramps, sheds, mines and rams together, and a walled town is no longer beyond an army's reach.
siege_engineering.ability_reason: Walls that once ended a war now only slow it; generals can plan a siege, not just a blockade.

paired_rider_teams.name: Paired Riders
paired_rider_teams.observation: Horse archers ride in pairs, one shooting while the other guards him and brings arrows.

iron_spear_levy.name: Iron Spearheads for the Levy
iron_spear_levy.observation: Every man of the levy now carries an iron spearhead, where once only the rich had bronze.
iron_spear_levy.ability_reason: Arms are no longer a noble's privilege; the whole levy fights with metal.
iron_spear_levy.social_consequence: Farmers armed with iron stand beside nobles in the line, and begin to ask for a say.

wheeled_siege_towers.name: Wheeled Siege Towers
wheeled_siege_towers.observation: Towers on wheels, hung with wet hides, roll up to the wall with a ram swinging in their base.

camel_riders.name: Camel Riders
camel_riders.observation: Camel riders patrol the desert routes and raid across country where horses would die of thirst.

bronze_ram_galleys.name: Bronze-ram Galleys
bronze_ram_galleys.observation: A bronze-sheathed ram on the galley's bow holes an enemy hull below the waterline.

town_fire_watch.name: Town Fire Watch
town_fire_watch.observation: Night watchmen carry buckets and hooks, and pull down a burning house before the whole street goes.

citizen_heavy_infantry.name: Citizen Heavy Infantry
citizen_heavy_infantry.observation: Farmers who can afford the bronze helmet, cuirass and great round shield fight shoulder to shoulder in the line.
citizen_heavy_infantry.ability_reason: The men who own the fields now hold the line, and their shields are the city's army.
citizen_heavy_infantry.social_consequence: Those who stand in the line expect a voice in the assembly.

closed_helmet_greaves.name: Closed Helmet and Greaves
closed_helmet_greaves.observation: A helmet beaten from one sheet of bronze covers the whole face, and greaves guard the shins below the shield.

chariot_to_cavalry_shift.name: Cavalry Replaces Chariots
chariot_to_cavalry_shift.observation: Riders on horseback now do what the chariot did, and cross broken ground no car could.
chariot_to_cavalry_shift.social_consequence: The old chariot houses lose their pride of place to horsemen of lesser birth.

unit_rally_standards.name: Rally Standards
unit_rally_standards.observation: Each company follows a standard on a pole, and in the confusion of battle the men rally to it.

siege_ration_reckoning.name: Siege Ration Reckoning
siege_ration_reckoning.observation: Stores are counted in days of grain per mouth, and the commander knows how long the town can hold.

road_bandit_patrols.name: Road Bandit Patrols
road_bandit_patrols.observation: Mounted patrols ride the trade roads and hang the bandits they catch at the crossroads.

contracted_mercenary_captains.name: Contracted Mercenary Captains
contracted_mercenary_captains.observation: Foreign captains bring their companies for a season's pay, and fight for whoever pays the next season.
contracted_mercenary_captains.social_consequence: Paid strangers guard the realm; when the silver stops, they may take what they were paid to defend.

three_banked_warships.name: Three-banked Warships
three_banked_warships.observation: Oarsmen in three banks drive long, narrow warships fast enough to ram before the enemy can turn.
three_banked_warships.ability_reason: Sea power now rests on long warships and their rowers; a fleet needs forests and crews by the thousand.

wet_moats.name: Wet Moats
wet_moats.observation: A ditch flooded from the river rings the walls, and rams and mines cannot reach their foot.

city_port_long_walls.name: Long Walls to the Harbor
city_port_long_walls.observation: Two long walls run from the city to its harbor, so it can be fed by sea while an army camps outside.

siege_evacuation_orders.name: Siege Evacuation Orders
siege_evacuation_orders.observation: Before the siege closes, the children, the old and the herds are sent away to allied towns.
siege_evacuation_orders.social_consequence: Families are split up for a siege, and not all of them come home to the same town.

crossbow_mechanism.observation: A trigger holds the drawn string until the bowman aims, and a weak arm can shoot a powerful bow.
crossbow_mechanism.ability_reason: A levy archer with a crossbow can be trained in weeks, not years.

multivallate_hillforts.name: Multiple-rampart Hill Forts
multivallate_hillforts.observation: Rings of rampart and ditch, one inside another, keep slingers and attackers at a distance from the gate.

bolt_throwing_frames.name: Bolt-throwing Frames
bolt_throwing_frames.observation: A great bow on a stand throws a heavy bolt farther than any archer can shoot.

scythed_chariots.name: Scythed Chariots
scythed_chariots.observation: Blades fixed to the wheels and pole of a chariot are driven into a packed line of infantry.

curved_chopping_sword.name: Curved Chopping Sword
curved_chopping_sword.observation: A forward-curved iron blade falls like a cleaver and bites through shield rims.

bowshot_tower_spacing.name: Bowshot Tower Spacing
bowshot_tower_spacing.observation: Towers stand a bowshot apart, so archers can sweep every stretch of wall from the side.

traction_stone_throwers.name: Traction Stone Throwers
traction_stone_throwers.observation: A crew hauling on ropes swings a beam that hurls stones over the wall.

siege_defense_manual.name: Siege Defense Manual
siege_defense_manual.observation: A written manual tells a town's defenders how to meet every trick of the besieger, from traitors to tunnels.

torsion_spring_engines.name: Torsion Engines
torsion_spring_engines.observation: Skeins of twisted sinew drive the arms of engines that throw bolts and stones far beyond bowshot.
torsion_spring_engines.ability_reason: Engines now outrange every archer; engineers can decide a siege from a distance.

long_pike_phalanx.name: Long-pike Phalanx
long_pike_phalanx.observation: Close ranks of men with pikes twice their height present a hedge of points five rows deep.

wedge_shock_cavalry.name: Wedge Shock Cavalry
wedge_shock_cavalry.observation: Horsemen with thrusting lances charge in a wedge through the gap the infantry opens.

countermine_listening.name: Countermines and Listening Jars
countermine_listening.observation: Bronze jars set in the ground ring when sappers dig nearby, and the defenders tunnel out to meet them.

incendiary_missiles.name: Incendiary Missiles
incendiary_missiles.observation: Pots of burning pitch and fire arrows set the besiegers' towers and sheds alight.

mail_armor_fabrication.observation: Thousands of small iron rings, each drawn, joined and inspected, make a shirt that turns blades and still flexes.
mail_armor_fabrication.ability_reason: Mail guards the whole body without the weight of plate; well-armored troops become common.

manipular_lines.name: Flexible Company Lines
manipular_lines.observation: Small blocks of men in three lines, with gaps between, can relieve a tired front and close around the enemy.

standard_trigger_locks.name: Standard Trigger Locks
standard_trigger_locks.observation: Bronze trigger locks cast to one pattern fit every crossbow, and armorers swap them in the field.

engine_proof_walls.name: Engine-proof Walls
engine_proof_walls.observation: Walls built thick enough to take the stone throwers' blows carry towers with engines of their own.

boarding_bridges.name: Boarding Bridges
boarding_bridges.observation: A hinged bridge with an iron spike drops onto the enemy's deck, and soldiers cross as if on land.

wall_repair_levy.name: Wall Repair Levy
wall_repair_levy.observation: After an earthquake or flood every household owes days of labor until the breaches in the wall are closed.
wall_repair_levy.social_consequence: The wall tax is paid in sweat, and no family is spared.

frontier_long_walls.name: Frontier Long Walls
frontier_long_walls.observation: A wall with forts and watchtowers runs for days along the frontier, and raiders must climb it under watch.
frontier_long_walls.ability_reason: A frontier can now be held by a line instead of the whole army; the realm pays for it in labor for generations.
frontier_long_walls.social_consequence: Whole villages are marched off to build and man the wall, and many never return.

nightly_marching_camps.name: Fortified Marching Camps
nightly_marching_camps.observation: Every evening the army digs a ditch and rampart to the same plan, and sleeps safe in enemy country.

heavy_javelin_volley.name: Heavy Javelin Volley
heavy_javelin_volley.observation: Each man throws two heavy javelins that pin the enemy's shields together, then draws his sword and charges.

armored_horse_cataphracts.name: Fully Armored Horsemen
armored_horse_cataphracts.observation: Horse and rider both go in mail and scale, and ride through arrows that empty lighter saddles.
armored_horse_cataphracts.ability_reason: Heavy horsemen can break a line head-on; the general's reserve becomes a hammer.

portcullis_gates.name: Portcullis Gates
portcullis_gates.observation: An iron-shod grille drops in its grooves and shuts the gate passage faster than any bar.

rotating_crossbow_ranks.name: Rotating Crossbow Ranks
rotating_crossbow_ranks.observation: Crossbowmen shoot in ranks, one loading while another aims and a third shoots, so the volleys never pause.

steel_cavalry_swords.name: Steel Cavalry Swords
steel_cavalry_swords.observation: Long swords with hardened steel edges give horsemen a blade that holds its edge through a battle.

standard_kit_issue.name: Standard Kit Issue
standard_kit_issue.observation: Every soldier draws the same armor, weapons, cloak and rations, and is paid on fixed days.

timber_laced_ramparts.name: Timber-laced Ramparts
timber_laced_ramparts.observation: A frame of timber beams inside the stone rampart holds it together against the rams.

horned_riding_saddle.name: Horned Riding Saddle
horned_riding_saddle.observation: A saddle with a horn at each corner locks the rider in place, so he can lean, strike and take a blow.
horned_riding_saddle.ability_reason: A secure seat lets riders fight with sword and lance at full force.

anti_piracy_squadrons.name: Anti-piracy Squadrons
anti_piracy_squadrons.observation: Squadrons of warships sweep the sea lanes and burn the pirates' harbors, and merchant ships sail without escort.

recruit_drill_schools.name: Recruit Drill Schools
recruit_drill_schools.observation: New recruits march, dig and fight with double-weight weapons for months before they join the line.

army_bridging_engineers.name: Army Bridging Engineers
army_bridging_engineers.observation: Army engineers throw a bridge of boats or timber across a river in days, while the enemy watches from the far bank.

long_service_enlistment.name: Long-service Enlistment
long_service_enlistment.observation: Men enlist for twenty years and more, and leave with land or money when their term is done.
long_service_enlistment.ability_reason: An army of career soldiers lasts a generation; generals command veterans, and the treasury pays for every one.
long_service_enlistment.social_consequence: Veterans' land is taken from someone; the discharged soldier and the dispossessed farmer do not love each other.

banded_plate_cuirass.name: Banded Plate Cuirass
banded_plate_cuirass.observation: Iron bands riveted over leather straps guard the chest and shoulders and pack flat on the march.

crossbow_sight_graduation.name: Graduated Crossbow Sights
crossbow_sight_graduation.observation: Marks on the crossbow's sight tell the shooter how high to aim at each distance.

force_pump_fire_engines.name: Force-pump Fire Engines
force_pump_fire_engines.observation: A pump on a cart throws a jet of water onto the blaze, and the watch fights fires from the street.

permanent_frontier_fortresses.name: Permanent Frontier Fortresses
permanent_frontier_fortresses.observation: Stone fortresses with barracks, granaries and baths house the frontier troops all year round.

lath_stiffened_bow.name: Lath-stiffened Bow
lath_stiffened_bow.observation: Bone laths glued at the tips make stiff levers, and the bow shoots heavier arrows farther.

frontier_spy_service.name: Frontier Spy Service
frontier_spy_service.observation: Agents beyond the frontier send word by courier of every muster and march across the border.

guarded_road_posts.name: Guarded Road Posts
guarded_road_posts.observation: Small detachments hold posts along the roads, and travelers move from one guarded stage to the next.

treaty_border_levies.name: Treaty Border Levies
treaty_border_levies.observation: Border peoples settled under treaty send their young men to guard the frontier in companies of their own.
treaty_border_levies.social_consequence: Foreign-born companies guard our border under their own chiefs and their own gods.

army_grain_levy.name: Army Grain Levy
army_grain_levy.observation: The provinces pay part of their tax in grain, delivered by cart and barge to the fort stores.
army_grain_levy.social_consequence: The tax-gatherer takes the grain before the family has eaten, in a bad year as in a good one.

two_handed_lancers.name: Two-handed Lancers
two_handed_lancers.observation: Mailed riders hold a long lance in both hands and drive it through shield and man.

contracted_circuit_walls.name: Contracted Circuit Walls
contracted_circuit_walls.observation: Towns give up their sprawling old walls for a shorter, higher circuit with projecting towers.
contracted_circuit_walls.social_consequence: Quarters left outside the new wall are abandoned, or pulled down for its stones.

single_mounting_stirrup.name: Mounting Stirrup
single_mounting_stirrup.observation: A single loop hanging from the saddle lets an armored rider climb onto a tall horse.

mobile_field_reserves.name: Mobile Field Reserves
mobile_field_reserves.observation: A field army of picked horse and foot waits behind the frontier forts and marches wherever the line is broken.
mobile_field_reserves.ability_reason: Generals no longer try to hold every mile; they hold the line thinly and strike with the reserve.

river_watch_posts.name: River Watch Posts
river_watch_posts.observation: Small forts along the river frontier watch the crossings and signal the patrol boats.
